description: This file defines the MenuLinkManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing discovery, instantiation, and tree building of menu link plugins, including handling plugin definitions, overrides, and related operations.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Menu\MenuLinkManager
classes.description: Manages discovery, instantiation, and tree building of menu link plugins within Drupal.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves all menu link plugin definitions, applying module alterations and filtering invalid providers.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the menu link tree storage with current definitions and overrides.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Fetches a specific menu link definition by plugin ID, optionally throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: hasDefinition
methods.description: Checks if a menu link definition exists for a given plugin ID.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a menu link plugin instance for a given plugin ID with optional configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a menu link instance based on provided options, primarily using the 'id' key.

methods.name: deleteLinksInMenu
methods.description: Deletes all menu links within a specified menu, supporting deletion or reset.

methods.name: deleteInstance
methods.description: Deletes a specific menu link plugin instance if it supports deletion.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes a menu link definition by ID, optionally persisting the deletion.

methods.name: menuNameInUse
methods.description: Checks if a menu name is already in use.

methods.name: countMenuLinks
methods.description: Counts the number of menu links, optionally within a specific menu.

methods.name: getParentIds
methods.description: Retrieves parent IDs for a given menu link ID.

methods.name: getChildIds
methods.description: Retrieves child IDs for a given menu link ID.

methods.name: loadLinksByRoute
methods.description: Loads menu link instances associated with a specific route and parameters.

methods.name: addDefinition
methods.description: Adds a new menu link definition and creates its plugin instance.

methods.name: updateDefinition
methods.description: Updates an existing menu link definition with new values.

methods.name: resetLink
methods.description: Resets a menu link to its default settings.

methods.name: resetInstance
methods.description: Resets a menu link plugin instance to its default state.

methods.name: resetDefinitions
methods.description: Resets all menu link definitions to their default state.
